technique_name: Write a paragraph describing the basic principles of psychoanalysis.
description: Psychoanalysis is a psychological approach developed by Sigmund Freud that uses a set of techniques aimed at uncovering hidden or repressed feelings, drives, and memories. Psychoanalysis seeks to understand the origin and nature of psychological distress and focuses on the ways in which an individual's psyche affects his or her behavior and mental wellbeing.
